limitations: Static analysis does not establish actual runtime behavior or malicious intent.
Static analysis may miss indirect or dynamic behavior.
recommendations: Inspect cited findings in source code.
Verify requested permissions against the stated extension purpose.
Use runtime testing in an isolated browser if deeper assurance is needed.
